Description: Code indicating the TPEP provider that provided the record. (1=Creative Mobile Technologies, LLC; 2=VeriFone Inc.)
Date and time when the meter was engaged.
Date and time when the meter was disengaged.
Number of passengers in the vehicle (driver-entered value).
Elapsed trip distance in miles reported by the taximeter.
Final rate code in effect at the end of the trip. (1=Standard rate, 2=JFK, 3=Newark, 4=Nassau/Westchester, 5=Negotiated fare, 6=Group ride)
Flag indicating whether the trip record was held in vehicle memory before sending to the vendor ("N" = not a store and forward trip, "Y" = store and forward trip).
TLC Taxi Zone in which the taximeter was engaged.
TLC Taxi Zone in which the taximeter was disengaged.
Numeric code signifying how the passenger paid for the trip. (1=Credit card, 2=Cash, 3=No charge, 4=Dispute, 5=Unknown, 6=Voided trip)
Time-and-distance fare calculated by the meter.
Miscellaneous extras and surcharges (e.g., general rush hour and overnight charges).
$0.50 MTA tax that is automatically triggered based on the metered rate in use.
Tip amount (automatically populated for credit card tips; cash tips are not included).
Total amount of all tolls paid in trip.
$0.30 improvement surcharge assessed on hailed trips at the drop off.
Total amount charged to passengers (does not include cash tips).
Congestion surcharge added for trips starting, ending, or passing through Manhattan below 96th street.
Surcharge for pickups at LaGuardia and JFK airports.
